audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Yone Levels 3, 4-5 and first item against a 58.7% Gwen win rate, and directly contradicts the prose ('By level 3 you have Q+E... even short trades favor you', 'This is where you take over', 'You own the straight duel through your first two items').
audit.corrected: Chart realigned in both layers; difficulty 6/10 lowered to 4/10 to match the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text with no timings.
audit.why: Gwen's spikes are Level 3 Q+E, Level 6 Mist and Riftmaker; Yone's is his third item. Mortal Steel is a flat 4s, Soul Unbound 22 down to 10s, Fate Sealed 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were never stated.
audit.why: Riot on Soul Unbound: 'When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit' — the body is a fixed, visible point, so you always know where he will reappear and when the stored damage lands. Riot on Spirit Cleave: 'Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit' — in a 1v1 it is at its minimum. Riot on Mortal Steel: only 'At 2 stacks' does it dash and knock Airborne, so counting casts beats watching a cooldown. Riot on Fate Sealed: 'Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line', which is why lining up with allies feeds it.
audit.corrected: All four written into the phase whys, cooldown block, trading rules, dos/donts and the interactions row.

audit.why: Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10s, Mortal Steel a flat 4s, Spirit Cleave 14s scaling down with attack speed.
audit.corrected: All written into the cooldown block.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Yone contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Even at 1. Mortal Steel is a flat 4s and only dashes with a knockup at two stacks — count the casts and step out on the second.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Yone's Soul Unbound is down.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave's shield scales with champions hit — against you alone it is the smallest it ever gets.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Yone must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Q+E online. He builds crit with almost no MR, so your %-max-HP magic and true-damage centre both bite hard.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Soul Unbound's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Soul Unbound forces his spirit back to his body when it ends — stand on the body and you know exactly where he reappears.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yone's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Mist his commit: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line, so alone in the fog there is nothing to line up on.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Soul Unbound's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — extended fights out-grind a Spirit Cleave shield off one champion.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-scales you from three items onward. Close the game before then, and never get caught alone with Hallowed Mist down.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Snip him there. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound (10-22s): his spirit is forced back to the body when it ends, and the stored damage repeats there. - Mortal Steel (4s): knocks up only at two stacks. - Spirit Cleave (14s): the shield scales with champions hit.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Yone with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Yone with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Mortal Steel sits at one stack — no knockup for another cast, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: lining up behind an ally when Fate Sealed is up, since it blinks behind the LAST champion hit.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Snip him there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His spirit snaps back to the body when it ends, and the stored damage lands.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Stand on his body — that is exactly where he must return.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Mortal Steel only dashes and knocks up on its second stack — count them.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Unbound repeats part of the damage he dealt when it ends.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave's shield grows with each champion it hits — duel him alone and it is at its weakest.

edits.before: Track Yone's Soul Unbound: He snaps back when it ends. Snip him there. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Soul Unbound forces his spirit back to his body, and Spirit Cleave's shield scales with champions hit.

edits.before: W-mist his E burst — Snip his HP at his snap-back. Gwen wins by trading around Yone's Soul Unbound and cashing the pattern: w-mist his E burst and Snip his snap-back.
edits.after: Stand on the body Soul Unbound must snap back to, duel him alone so Spirit Cleave shields for the minimum, and mist the two-stack Mortal Steel knockup.

notes: The stored level chart gave Yone four of seven rows on a 58.7% Gwen win rate and contradicted the page's own prose in every one of them. The interactions that make the lane winnable — Soul Unbound returning to a fixed body, Spirit Cleave shielding least in a 1v1, and Mortal Steel only knocking up at two stacks — were all absent.
